title_ref: Daily admission tariff — APAI basis (rate master 'Day Rate' sheet)
rate_basis: per night, per villa, single or double occupancy, APAI basis: accommodation, all meals (vegetarian), one Ayurvedic herbal oil massage per person, one physician consultation, one yoga & meditation session

components_inr.room_gst_note: Room component includes GST at 5% as recorded in the sheet (rows 5-16); meals and treatment components carry no separate tax line in the sheet.

inclusions_source: The above Prices are inclusive of Accommodation, All Meals (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner–Veg. Only), One Ayurvedic Herbal Oil Massage Per Person, One Doctor’s Consultation, One Yoga & Meditation Session. (Day Rate sheet B67)
